title: LEGO Produced 10 Billion Minifigures For 8.1 Billion People
hook: LEGO produced 10 billion minifigures—more than one for every person alive.
closing: Production totals can dwarf living populations without proving every toy still exists.
question: How many minifigures do you own?

segments.say: LEGO has produced 10 billion minifigures. That cumulative total exceeds the number of people alive today.
LEGO production reached 8.3 billion before the latest total. A toy line grew to humanity-scale in four decades.
LEGO now makes 400 million minifigures yearly. Production outpaces births and keeps widening the cumulative gap.
